name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Performance Marketing Manager
summary: Performance marketing professional with 15+ years driving campaign strategy, budget accountability, and structured testing across agency and SaaS environments. Built ROI/CAC/LTV reporting frameworks and ran regular experimentation and optimization cycles on paid search and CRM-driven channels, diagnosing performance shifts and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to leadership.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution and analysis across internal departments.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Translated performance data into strategic recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor campaign outputs, separating signal from noise and continuously optimizing conversion rates.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to business owners on a regular cadence.
Conduct competitor research and keyword-gap analyses, translating findings into campaign and content recommendations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data at a performance marketing agency, translating results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Built and refined internal reporting processes that improved accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics across a reseller portfolio to identify the true drivers behind adoption gaps and recommend interventions.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a consumer loyalty and marketing automation platform targeting SMBs, from prospecting through customer acquisition.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
